notes: Version 2.47 records the I-5 correction in no-scale 2.0 and its consumers NIF-Note 1.7, SAN 2.1 and Gram rigidity 1.16. The Level 1 rigidity theorem of no-scale (no dimensional parameter independent of the Born–Infeld constant c_BI can enter the admissibility constraints), its corollary on fields with an independent dimensional coupling, and its application to Reissner–Nordström and Schwarzschild–de Sitter exteriors are withdrawn: the proof used premises that the cited papers do not contain (a power law for the pair capacity, a continuum limit, a fibre-weight requirement, Foundation axioms fixing a unique primitive scale), and each of its cases had internal gaps. The failure of the proof does not decide the question, and Level 1 is recorded as open. The model does not fix the physical dimension of c_BI; no-scale keeps a dimensional-homogeneity observation on the amplitude bound under a supplied dimensional assignment. The registry no longer states that dimensional analysis in the framework is fully constrained by c_BI alone or that the naturalness question is closed. The noscale entry, inventory row, Fig. 1 node and interactive-graph node move from proved to open; NIF-Note and SAN record the claim as withdrawn and unused; Gram rigidity records its classification as scale-free. The Fig. 1 caption now states that the arrows O5→O7 and O13→O15 abbreviate the sub-chains O5→O6→O7 and O13→O14→O15 of the interactive graph.
